purpose.text: Typed failures produced while lowering and compiling a Session declaration.

responsibilities: pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError: Classifies failures surfaced by session compile operations.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::InvalidSpec: Reports that the supplied spec is invalid.
SessionCompileError::UnknownOperator::operator_id: Identifies the operator identifier recorded by `UnknownOperator`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownOperator: Reports that the referenced operator is not declared or registered.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::OperatorNodeTypeMismatch: Reports that operator node type does not match the expected contract.
SessionCompileError::OperatorNodeTypeMismatch::operator_id: Identifies the operator identifier recorded by `OperatorNodeTypeMismatch`.
SessionCompileError::OperatorNodeTypeMismatch::registered_node_type_id: Identifies the registered node type identifier recorded by `OperatorNodeTypeMismatch`.
SessionCompileError::OperatorNodeTypeMismatch::declared_node_type_id: Identifies the declared node type identifier recorded by `OperatorNodeTypeMismatch`.
SessionCompileError::UnknownAsyncOperator::operator_id: Identifies the operator identifier recorded by `UnknownAsyncOperator`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownAsyncOperator: Reports that the referenced async operator is not declared or registered.
SessionCompileError::UnknownEndpointNodeType::node_type_id: Identifies the node type identifier recorded by `UnknownEndpointNodeType`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownEndpointNodeType: Reports that the referenced endpoint node type is not declared or registered.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::AmbiguousEndpointInput: Reports that endpoint input resolves to more than one candidate.
SessionCompileError::AmbiguousEndpointInput::node_type_id: Identifies the node type identifier recorded by `AmbiguousEndpointInput`.
SessionCompileError::AmbiguousEndpointInput::input_ports_total: Counts the total number of input ports observed by `AmbiguousEndpointInput`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::AmbiguousOperatorPort: Reports that operator port resolves to more than one candidate.
SessionCompileError::AmbiguousOperatorPort::operator_id: Identifies the operator identifier recorded by `AmbiguousOperatorPort`.
SessionCompileError::AmbiguousOperatorPort::direction: Records the direction selected for `AmbiguousOperatorPort`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownOperatorPort: Reports that the referenced operator port is not declared or registered.
SessionCompileError::UnknownOperatorPort::operator_id: Identifies the operator identifier recorded by `UnknownOperatorPort`.
SessionCompileError::UnknownOperatorPort::direction: Records the direction selected for `UnknownOperatorPort`.
SessionCompileError::UnknownOperatorPort::port_name: Stores the human-readable port used to identify `UnknownOperatorPort`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::MissingRequiredOperatorInput: Reports that the required required operator input is missing.
SessionCompileError::MissingRequiredOperatorInput::operator_instance_id: Identifies the operator instance identifier recorded by `MissingRequiredOperatorInput`.
SessionCompileError::MissingRequiredOperatorInput::port_name: Stores the human-readable port used to identify `MissingRequiredOperatorInput`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::InvalidAudioBridgeOutput: Reports that the supplied audio bridge output is invalid.
SessionCompileError::InvalidAudioBridgeOutput::operator_instance_id: Identifies the operator instance identifier recorded by `InvalidAudioBridgeOutput`.
SessionCompileError::InvalidAudioBridgeOutput::output_port: References the output port participating in `InvalidAudioBridgeOutput`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::AudioBridgeOutputNotExclusive: Reports that audio bridge output must have exclusive ownership but is shared.
SessionCompileError::AudioBridgeOutputNotExclusive::operator_instance_id: Identifies the operator instance identifier recorded by `AudioBridgeOutputNotExclusive`.
SessionCompileError::AudioBridgeOutputNotExclusive::output_port: References the output port participating in `AudioBridgeOutputNotExclusive`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::DuplicateOperatorInputConnection: Reports that operator input connection duplicates an existing declaration or record.
SessionCompileError::DuplicateOperatorInputConnection::operator_instance_id: Identifies the operator instance identifier recorded by `DuplicateOperatorInputConnection`.
SessionCompileError::DuplicateOperatorInputConnection::port_name: Stores the human-readable port used to identify `DuplicateOperatorInputConnection`.
SessionCompileError::UnknownSourceNodeType::node_type_id: Identifies the node type identifier recorded by `UnknownSourceNodeType`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownSourceNodeType: Reports that the referenced source node type is not declared or registered.
SessionCompileError::UnknownExternalSource::source_type_id: Identifies the source type identifier recorded by `UnknownExternalSource`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownExternalSource: Reports that the referenced external source is not declared or registered.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownExternalSourceOutput: Reports that the referenced external source output is not declared or registered.
SessionCompileError::UnknownExternalSourceOutput::source_type_id: Identifies the source type identifier recorded by `UnknownExternalSourceOutput`.
SessionCompileError::UnknownExternalSourceOutput::output_port: References the output port participating in `UnknownExternalSourceOutput`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::InvalidExternalSourceConfiguration: Reports that the supplied external source configuration is invalid.
SessionCompileError::InvalidExternalSourceConfiguration::source_type_id: Identifies the source type identifier recorded by `InvalidExternalSourceConfiguration`.
SessionCompileError::InvalidExternalSourceConfiguration::reason: Carries the reason reported by `InvalidExternalSourceConfiguration`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::UnknownEndpointInputPort: Reports that the referenced endpoint input port is not declared or registered.
SessionCompileError::UnknownEndpointInputPort::node_type_id: Identifies the node type identifier recorded by `UnknownEndpointInputPort`.
SessionCompileError::UnknownEndpointInputPort::port_name: Stores the human-readable port used to identify `UnknownEndpointInputPort`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::GraphCompile: Classifies a failure at the graph compile stage or component of `SessionCompileError`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileError::RuntimePlan: Classifies a failure at the runtime plan stage or component of `SessionCompileError`.
pocketstation::session::compile::error::SessionCompileDiagnostic: Stable, language-neutral location facts for one Session compilation error.
code: Returns the stable error or status code represented by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
node_index: Returns the node index held by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
edge_index: Returns the edge index held by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
operator_id: Returns the operator identifier held by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
operator_instance_id: Returns the operator instance identifier held by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
node_type_id: Returns the node type identifier held by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
source_type_id: Returns the source type identifier held by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
port_name: Returns the port name held by `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
direction: Returns the direction associated with `SessionCompileDiagnostic`.
expected: Returns the expected value when a compilation diagnostic compares two values.
actual: Returns the observed value when a compilation diagnostic compares two values.
diagnostic: Converts a Session compiler failure into stable language-neutral location and comparison fields.
